page_title: MON 0-1 LAZ | Monza v Lazio 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
90+4' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Monza have a free kick from a promising distance.
90+3' A cross from a corner kick by Monza is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+3' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Monza win a corner.
90+3' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+2' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Matteo Guendouzi will be replaced by Samuel Gigot (Lazio).

90+1' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
89' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
89' Here is a change. Pedro Pereira is going off and Alessandro Nesta gives the last tactical orders to Samuele Birindelli (Monza).
89' That will be all from Warren Bondo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Andrea Petagna (Monza).
88' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
86' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
86' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

85' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Taty Castellanos (Lazio) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Stefano Turati pulls off a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
83' The foul by Matteo Pessina (Monza) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andrea Colombo.
81' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
77' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Andrea Colombo didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
75' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) replaces Nuno Tavares.
75' Today's match ends for Mattia Zaccagni who will be replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Maldini departs the field of play to be replaced by Gianluca Caprari (Monza).
74' Daniel Maldini (Monza) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
72' CHANCE! Daniel Maldini (Monza) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
71' Armando Izzo (Monza) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
70' Corner kick. Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is ready to send the ball into the box.
70' Pedro Pereira (Monza) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Monza win a corner.
70' Wasted effort! Nuno Tavares (Lazio) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
69' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
68' Daniel Maldini (Monza) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Monza will take a corner kick.
67' Daniel Maldini (Monza) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
65' Dany Mota (Monza) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
65' The referee blows his whistle, Monza are awarded a corner kick.
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pedro Pereira (Monza).

63' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
60' A substitution has been made. Boulaye Dia is replaced by Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
60' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Pedro is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
58' The referee blows his whistle as Warren Bondo (Monza) was too aggressive in his challenge.
57' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Daniel Maldini (Monza) for a tough tackle.
55' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andrea Carboni as he is replaced by Matteo Pessina (Monza).
55' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) is booked for saying more than Andrea Colombo was willing to tolerate.

53' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Stefano Turati pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
52' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
50' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
49' Adam Marusic (Lazio) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the left post.
46' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
44' Dany Mota (Monza) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
43' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
41' Dangerous play by Daniel Maldini (Monza). Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
39' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pedro Pereira (Monza), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
36' 0 - 1 Goal! Matteo Guendouzi slips it to Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) on the edge of the box and he finds the right side of the net with a great effort. The score is 0:1.

36' Pedro (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Lazio will have a throw-in.
34' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
32' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Pedro. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
30' A crossfield pass from Andrea Carboni (Monza) fails to find any of his teammates.
28' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
27' The ball goes out of play and Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Dany Mota (Monza) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play and Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
23' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
20' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
19' Pedro (Lazio) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
18' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
18' Pedro Pereira (Monza) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
17' Andrea Carboni (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
16' Dany Mota (Monza) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
15' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Lazio get a corner.
14' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
13' The corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is intercepted by the defence.

11' Great save! Boulaye Dia (Lazio) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Stefano Turati. The ball is out of play and Lazio manage to earn a corner.
10' Daniel Maldini (Monza) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
7' Armando Izzo (Monza) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Andrea Colombo signals.
6' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lazio.

5' Monza slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
2' Dany Mota (Monza) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo will referee today's match.
